categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the P2P label and modifies connection management and socket polling in src/net.cpp and src/netbase.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents a potential busy loop in the P2P network event loop caused by incoming TCP urgent data. As noted in commit 1fde57f1de, on POSIX systems 'a TCP urgent pointer can leave the exception set pending even when no data is readable', which causes select() to spin continuously.

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Touches src/util/sock.cpp minimally (+3/-0), but the change serves P2P event loop exception handling rather than general utility primitives.
categories.rationale: Not a utilities PR; socket polling changes directly target network connection handling.
